about: The test TGS in data/test/ (swanston-smac-lane-closure.jpg): Swanston St between Faraday St and Grattan St, Carlton, opposite the Sidney Myer Asia Centre. Southbound closed at Faraday St, Monday to Friday 9:30am to 3:30pm, detour via Faraday St, Cardigan St and Grattan St. Run the scripts with SUMO_SITE=smac; they then work in work/smac/ and output/smac/.
name: Swanston Street, Faraday Street to Grattan Street
signal_plans_note: Swanston St / Faraday St (site 4392) runs its 2024 signal sheet's phases, with drivers turning left into Faraday St held for the pedestrian walk. Every other junction keeps netconvert's delay-based guess. Grattan St / Swanston St (4391) has only a 2014 sheet from before the junction was rebuilt, so it is not used.
vclasses_note: Car streets only. With the tram tracks in the network (as in the CBD run) the junctions along Elgin St and Lygon St get signal programs that jam in the afternoon: 8% of cars dropped from 2:30pm, against 0.1% without. No tram services are simulated either way.
